outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed in frame 0 (image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with the upper door handle, then pulls the door outward and downward during frames 110–131 (image and left_ego_image). Frames 131–140 show the door remaining open with the oven interior exposed. No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or displacement of the nearby plates is established; the pause near the handle does not clearly establish a local failure.
